value.rationale: The 2023 focal paper motivates sharp best concentration but provides asymptotic/eigenvalue-count results. The exact conditional-mean criterion is uniform over all radial masks and dimensions, determines every optimizer multiplicity, and proves a genuine two-transition finite annulus phase with width decaying as d^-2. The explicit nonconstant two-ring disk indicator has a scalar compression on the entire degree≤2 polynomial band, demonstrating indistinguishable low-band energy for distinct apertures. This structural classification and spectral-camouflage boundary, not merely numerical or normalized arithmetic, are the motivated mathematical contribution.
